notes.title: Small update.
notes.content:
Hello, gamers! 🎮

We’re excited to announce a small update for our game, which includes fixes for some minor bugs. Your comfort and enjoyment are our top priorities, so we’re constantly working to improve your gaming experience.

Thank you for your support and feedback!

Stay tuned and enjoy the game! 🌟
